item.title: Attention Restoration: Remote Work & a Vibrant Social Life
item.description:
Two weeks into my focus restoration plan I decided to extend the experimental design to test more tools for enhancing focus and productivity. Specifically, I chose to work from a remote location. This technique has been employed by many important writers acadmics and buisness mans, when seaprting themself from they reguler enviorment help them imrove thir focus from Bill Gates to Charles Darwin and from agata cristy to carl yong. this method serve some of the finest mind in history
Still while I traveled to a remote place, I had no intention of isolating myself. On the contrary, I specifically chose a town where I have friends I was eager to see. This dual approach led me to explore two core questions:
